title: 7S.3 POLYLINE frame-batch rollback fast slice
mode: Local implementation slice with generated in-memory controls
scope: Remove the facade's document-wide writer snapshot from ordinary POLYLINE/VERTEX/SEQEND emission.
Preserve exact frame, object-map, owner-index, and caller-state rollback after a partial compound write.

behavior: For dwgWriter15-family writers advertising retained entity rollback, retain compact per-frame checkpoints for a contiguous POLYLINE/VERTEX/SEQEND batch when no emitted handle is explicitly class-associated.
Validate the object-map suffix, emitted-handle membership, common owner, owner-list suffix, and absence of INSERT references before reverse rollback mutates state.
Retain the comprehensive snapshot for unsupported writers and class-associated handles; explicit caller transactions continue to own their existing full checkpoint.
Clear stale retained-frame rollback state after a compound rollback.
testChanges: Extends the existing --block-owner-membership-index selector with a generated two-vertex polyline, receipt-role checks, zero full-checkpoint assertion, and implicit rollback that preserves an already-written LINE.
Injects a missing vertex frame receipt and a SEQEND-stage failure; both paths remove all successfully emitted prefix frames and restore parent/vertex caller handles.
Exercises an enclosing caller-mutation-tracking transaction and asserts exactly its one full checkpoint, with no additional polyline snapshot.

diffCheck.command: git diff --check -- src/intern/dwgwriter15.cpp src/intern/dwgwriter15.h src/libdwgr.cpp tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md

limitations: The zero-full-checkpoint assertion is deterministic work evidence, not a measured throughput improvement.
The fast rollback helper intentionally accepts only one-owner batches with no INSERT-reference effects; unsupported writers and explicitly class-associated handles retain full snapshots.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty and repository Git metadata is read-only; this slice is uncommitted.
nextReadinessSlice: Audit the next locally actionable high-cardinality writer path for a bounded rollback suffix. Keep comprehensive snapshots where deferred ledgers, multiple owners, or INSERT-reference effects cannot be safely isolated.
